selection_method: Before model inference: visually inspect all 20 official Depth Anything examples, retain the four indoor photographs demo10, demo13, demo14, demo15; reject illustrations, paintings, artistic composites and outdoor scenes. Add the real COCO cats-on-sofa image used by the official metric model card. All five selected photos and every prediction are retained; no outcome-based removal, no crop, no synthetic images. Reviewed originals, contact sheet and reviewed-candidates.json retain the selection audit trail.
source_attempts: Six CC-licensed Commons sources were researched first, but downloads returned HTTP429 even after Retry-After; no Commons photo was evaluated. Their API metadata is retained in source-metadata.json. Direct COCO HTTPS failed certificate verification; the official Hugging Face mirror succeeded without disabling TLS verification.
measurement_note: Distances are model estimates, not verified physical distances. Indoor photographs have no depth ground truth, camera calibration or capture-scale reference. Positive/negative classifications test application behavior only. Reflections and glassware are challenging scenes.
